boards.label: Meta UFC Rankings
boards.note: UFC's default view since June 22, 2026: rankings calculated from fight data by UFC and Meta, updated by the Monday after each UFC event. The Meta rankings have no pound-for-pound list.

boards.label: Media panel rankings
boards.note: Voted by a panel of media members. Includes the men's and women's pound-for-pound lists. UFC is transitioning from this panel to the Meta rankings.

movement_note: Arrows: change since the previous update, as given by UFC. NR = not previously ranked.
